decision_scores.question: Target platform
decision_scores.chosen: A) Quarkus 3.x — first-class CDI/JAX-RS/JPA support, Red Hat successor to JBoss EAP
decision_scores.notes: All phases completed successfully. CDI, JAX-RS, and JPA migrations completed without code-related issues. EJB conversions to CDI completed cleanly in Service Layer - Simple phase (0 fix iterations). The choice proved correct as all Java EE 7 APIs mapped directly to Quarkus extensions.

decision_scores.question: Java version
decision_scores.chosen: B) Java 21 — current LTS, recommended for Quarkus 3.x
decision_scores.notes: Implementation used Java 17 (Quarkus 3 minimum) rather than Java 21, and no Java version-related issues were encountered. Build passed successfully. The decision to use a modern Java version (17+) was correct.

decision_scores.question: How to handle EJB session beans?
decision_scores.notes: Service Layer - Simple phase completed with 0 fix iterations. All EJB @Stateless beans converted to @ApplicationScoped, @Stateful to @SessionScoped without issues. This was the cleanest phase of the migration, demonstrating the 1:1 mapping effectiveness.

decision_scores.question: How to handle JMS messaging (MessageDriven beans)?
decision_scores.chosen: A) SmallRye Reactive Messaging with in-memory connector
decision_scores.notes: Service Layer - Complex phase required 1 fix iteration. Converting MDBs to @Incoming required adding quarkus-smallrye-reactive-messaging dependency (4 compilation errors fixed). Once dependency was added, the conversions completed successfully. The pattern is sound but required additional dependency not initially in the plan.

decision_scores.question: How to handle persistence.xml and JPA configuration?
decision_scores.notes: Model & Persistence phase and Configuration phase both completed with 0 fix iterations. JNDI datasource 'java:jboss/datasources/CoolstoreDS' successfully migrated to quarkus.datasource.* properties. No persistence-related issues encountered.

decision_scores.question: How to handle WebLogic vendor-specific code?
decision_scores.chosen: A) Delete vendor stubs and replace with Quarkus equivalents
decision_scores.notes: Utilities & Lifecycle phase completed with 0 fix iterations. ApplicationLifecycleListener successfully replaced with Quarkus @Observes StartupEvent/ShutdownEvent pattern. Cleanup phase removed all WebLogic stub classes without issues.

decision_scores.question: How to handle Flyway database migrations?
decision_scores.chosen: A) Use quarkus-flyway extension with migrations in src/main/resources/db/migration
decision_scores.notes: Configuration phase completed with 0 fix iterations. Quarkus-flyway extension integrated successfully. No Flyway-related compilation or runtime issues encountered during migration.

decision_scores.question: How to handle the local JAR dependency (audit-logging-library-1.0.0.jar)?
decision_scores.chosen: C) Deploy to internal Maven repository (Nexus/Artifactory)
decision_scores.notes: Project Setup phase required 2 fix iterations. The library was installed to local Maven repository (mvn install:install-file) rather than deployed to internal repository. This resolved build issues but doesn't fully address team collaboration concerns. System-scoped dependency was successfully removed.

decision_scores.question: How to handle JAX-RS configuration (RestApplication)?
decision_scores.chosen: A) Keep @ApplicationPath, remove Application class boilerplate
decision_scores.notes: REST API phase completed with 0 fix iterations. JAX-RS Application class maintained with @ApplicationPath('/api'). Quarkus auto-discovery worked correctly. Bulk javax to jakarta migration completed successfully.

decision_scores.question: How to serve the frontend AngularJS application?
decision_scores.notes: No frontend serving issues encountered during migration. Implementation plan references static resource serving, and no related compilation or configuration errors appeared in execute results.

decision_scores.question: Build packaging format
decision_scores.chosen: A) JAR packaging with embedded server (Quarkus standard)
decision_scores.notes: Packaging changed from WAR to JAR in Step 3 (Project Setup). Build passed with JAR packaging. No packaging-related issues encountered. Fast-jar format successfully adopted.

decision_scores.question: How to handle CDI beans.xml?
decision_scores.chosen: A) Remove beans.xml (CDI enabled by default in Quarkus)
decision_scores.notes: Cleanup phase completed with 0 fix iterations. beans.xml removed successfully (Step 51). Quarkus ArC CDI implementation worked without explicit beans.xml configuration.

decision_scores.question: How to handle web.xml deployment descriptor?
decision_scores.chosen: A) Remove web.xml (not needed in Quarkus)
decision_scores.notes: Cleanup phase completed with 0 fix iterations. web.xml removed successfully (Step 50). No servlet container configuration issues encountered. JAX-RS and security configuration migrated to application.properties.
